title: At a Senate hearing, Trump's CISA director nominee Michael LoSapio dodged questions about the agency's priorities, denied January 6 was an attack, and more (Eric Geller/Cybersecurity Dive)
summary: Eric Geller / Cybersecurity Dive: At a Senate hearing, Trump's CISA director nominee Michael LoSapio dodged questions about the agency's priorities, denied January 6 was an attack, and more — Michael LoSapio, a Palantir executive, also denied that the U.S. Capitol was attacked on Jan. 6, 2021.
